name: Prospect of Faith
summary: In the Badlands, Hammertoe Grez sends you to Prospector Ryedol with his amulet. Ryedol knows Hammertoe sought the origins of their people and wants to keep the scrolls from the Shadowforge clan.

sections.title: An Amulet for Ryedol
sections.body: Wounded in the Badlands, Hammertoe Grez asks you to carry his amulet to Ryedol. He trusts Ryedol to know what to do. Hammertoe sought the origins of their people and meant to thwart the Shadowforge clan. The clan must not get the scrolls.

sections.title: At Ryedol's Hands
sections.body: When Ryedol receives Hammertoe's amulet, he says spirits were higher when Hammertoe was thought dead. Knowing for certain only deepens his pain. Ryedol calls the amulet Hammertoe's life's work and vows his death will not be in vain.

faq.answer: Prospector Ryedol is the one you are to bring Hammertoe's amulet to in the Badlands. He knows what Hammertoe was seeking.

faq.q: What is Hammertoe Grez trying to stop?
faq.answer: Hammertoe meant to thwart the Shadowforge clan, which must not get hold of the scrolls.
Hammertoe was seeking the origins of their people.

faq.q: Which chain is this step part of?
faq.answer: This step is part of the chain that began with A Sign of Hope.
